t: GO partners with Talexio to expand business services
html:
GO has partnered with workforce management platform Talexio to introduce human resources and payroll tools into its Business Plus proposition, marking a further step in the telecoms group’s efforts to expand beyond connectivity services.

In line with GO’s Business Customer Promise, the new partnership with Talexio extends GO’s commitment beyond connectivity for the first time, giving Business Plus customers direct access to a practical tool from a trusted partner, tackling one of the most time-consuming parts of running a small business: managing people.

Ayrton Caruana, Chief of Business at GO plc said: “Our Business Promise is about becoming our business customers’ trusted partner, beyond connectivity. When running a small business in Malta, HR is often one of the most time-consuming. With Talexio, we’re giving our Business Plus customers a practical, locally-relevant tool that takes the complexity out of managing people, so they can focus on what they do best.”

Partnership brings HR and payroll tools to GO Business Plus customers as telecoms group broadens its offering to Maltese businesses

Through this partnership, Talexio will enable small businesses with up to 5 employees to bring essential HR functions together in one platform, helping them manage employee records, shifts, attendance, leave and automated payroll, all aligned with Maltese tax, Social Security and employment requirements. The system is automatically updated as regulations change, giving business owners greater peace of mind and more time to focus on running their business.

Mark Camilleri Gambin, CEO and Co-Founder of Talexio, said, “Partnering with GO, a company known for its exceptional commitment to business connectivity, brings us one step closer to fulfilling our core mission: to improve individual and organisational wellbeing. Through this collaboration, we are making HR and payroll management easier and more effective for growing businesses, ensuring best practices in people and pay management are accessible to all.”

To mark the launch, GO Business Plus customers can enjoy 3 months free of Talexio, alongside 6 months free of Business Plus, making it easier than ever for small businesses to get started with smarter people management.

Visit www.go.com.mt/business/talexio-hr-platform/ to learn more and claim your 3 months free of Talexio with 6 months free of Business Plus.
